model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the category distribution of a dataset, with each slice representing a different category and its corresponding proportion. The largest segment, colored red, represents "chat" and accounts for 41.2% of the total. The second largest segment, in blue, corresponds to "math" and makes up 21.9% of the dataset. The "tooluse" category, shown in green, constitutes 11.6% of the data. The "multi turn chat" category, in orange, represents 9.3% of the dataset. The "code" category, displayed in light purple, accounts for 9.0% of the data. The smallest segment, in pink, represents "instruction follow" and makes up 6.9% of the dataset. A legend in the upper left corner provides a key to the categories, their corresponding colors, and their raw counts: chat (546,526), math (290,496), tooluse (154,358), multi turn chat (123,615), code (119,563), and instruction follow (91,460). The percentages are labeled directly on the chart near each respective slice.
